thread:
maya: Quick sync — proposal to move billing-key resolution into the ingress fast-path (before any enrichment) so we can avoid a bunch of late-join attribution and expensive backfills. Short summary: resolve tenant/billing key at proxy time, attach compact cost-hint header, and only fall back to late lookup if missing.

kevin: TL;DR: lower backfill risk and cheaper queries down the pipeline, but extra work on the edge proxies + small increase in request size. what perf numbers do we expect?

maya: rough numbers from the prototype: +150us median on proxy (node) for a cache hit, +6B header on average. For our top 20k/s edge traffic that maps to ~3-5% token/ingest cost increase but cuts late-join attribution queries by ~70%.

ash: Concern: idempotency and retries. If proxy attaches a billing header and a retry goes to a different proxy without cache, we might double-charge or mis-attribute unless downstream trusts a canonical resolve policy. How do we force a single source-of-truth?

maya: plan: header format has two fields: resolved_billing and resolve_version. Downstream enforcement: once a resolve_version is present, downstream must prefer header over lookup unless header is explicitly marked stale. We'll add short-lived signer (HMAC) to avoid spoofing.

sam: rollout question — how do we verify the header integrity and not break clients? we should canary on internal services only first. also need an observability plan.

maya: agreed. suggested rollout: internal-only 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% across regions. Observability to track:
- billing.resolve_success_rate
- billing.lookup_fallback_rate
- ingest.header_size_p95
- ingest.proxy_latency_p50/p95
- cost.attribution_mismatch_rate (compared to late-join baseline)

kevin: sampling interactions: if we sample traces very early, the resolved header must survive sampling decisions. If a sampled trace drops the header, we lose cost mapping for that sample. Can we stash the billing key in KV cache used by the sampler?

ash: also need to think about encrypted/bounded headers for PII-sensitive tenants. For regulated customers we should support PII-free hints (tenant-hash + profile) and have a config flag to opt-out of resolved headers.

maya: yes — support opt-out and opt-in per-tenant. default for enterprise customers will be opt-in to server-side resolve with HSM-backed signer.

maya: example header (proto) we prototype: 
```
X-RW-Cost: tk=tbld_abc123;rv=2;sig=base64(hmac);
X-RW-Cost-Hint: svc=ingest;op=gen
```
Downstream pseudo-check: prefer X-RW-Cost if rv present else call billing-lookup.

sam: for metrics, add a canary dashboard with delta between header-based attribution and lookup-based attribution so we see drift during rollout. Also alert on >1% drift sustained for 10m.

kevin: fallback behavior: if header is invalid or missing, call lookup async and tag event with late_join=true. Don't block ingest (best-effort). But we must mark those events for post-hoc re-attribution.

ash: how do we handle sampling + re-attribution? If we later attribute cost to an event that was sampled out, reconciling will be tricky. Suggest we log re-attribution events to a short-lived topic and keep a mapping for 24h to replay to analytics.

maya: agreed — re-attribution queue with idempotent writes. We'll keep mapping TTL=24h, replay to billing joiner service that can patch aggregates.

obs-bot: deploy: billing-fastpath canary started in us-west-2 (flag: billing_fastpath=v1, cohort=1%).

sam: great. action items: maya to open RFC follow-up PR with header schema + signer spec; kevin to add proxy perf benchmark harness; ash to draft idempotency + replay doc; me (sam) to build canary dashboard and SLO alerts.

kevin: +1 on the plan. quick Q: can we make header format extendable (TLV) so future fields (quantization profile, batch-hint) can be appended without changing parsing?

maya: TLV-style semi-colon kv already used in proto above. will formalize in spec.

ash: i'll start the idempotency doc and include failure scenarios (cross-proxy retry, partial signer rotation).

sam: tagging for rollout: i'll coordinate with SRE to reserve capacity and a rollback playbook.

maya: thanks everyone — will drop the RFC PR link here when ready. :rocket:

kevin: :thumbsup:

ash: :+1:

sam: ack
